assets.name: facade
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: architectural atmosphere background for an elegant interactive digital museum portfolio; ordinary HTML interface and content will be layered separately
Style/medium: exceptionally refined architectural visualization, luminous warm-white contemporary museum inspired by restrained classical proportions, pale limestone, soft daylight, airy monumental spaces. Composed 2.5D spatial scene, tangible natural materials, convincing physically realistic soft shadows, tasteful gallery atmosphere, quietly luxurious but contemporary.
Color palette: warm ivory and pale chalk limestone, soft cream white, muted sage-green plants, microscopic brushed brass details; no strong yellow cast.
Materials/textures: finely honed limestone with subtle grain and quiet seams, lightly polished pale stone floors, thin brass edge accents and pale oak accents, clear glazing.
Composition/framing: panoramic landscape aspect ratio 16:9, eye-level architectural camera, straight verticals, restrained wide angle without exaggerated distortion, coherent real architecture, usable responsive crop. Crisp fine details, natural atmospheric perspective.
Constraints: no people, no text, no typography, no signs, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Not a palace. Avoid mythology, columns with ornate capitals, ornate gold, baroque, excessive symmetry ornaments, busy decorations, fantasy, cartoon, oversaturation, black marble, dramatic dark cinematic lighting.
Primary request: exterior facade of this contemporary museum, monumental calm architecture. A broad symmetrical pale limestone museum front with tall simplified rectangular piers and a very large central glazed entrance, slim brass door hardware. Side wings with deeply recessed rectangular windows. Two tasteful understated green trees in stone planters at outer edges. The architecture is contemporary with carefully proportioned classical rhythms and subtle cornice-like shadow lines only. Wide empty open pale-stone foreground occupying lower third for an inviting arrival. Front-on slightly elevated view from across the forecourt, entrance at exact horizontal center, quiet pale-blue sky occupying upper fifth. The building spans most of the image but has enough breathing room around it. Sunlight from upper right, long delicate shadows to left. Absolutely no letters or signage anywhere.
assets.purpose: Decorative architectural atmosphere; portfolio content and controls remain accessible HTML
